leaked_early.details: La Jolla's unsolicited proposal and interest were publicly disclosed via 8-K filing on May 6, 2020, more than one month before the official announcement, and widely reported.

notes: Tetraphase, a commercial antibiotic company with near-bankruptcy risk, went through a competitive multi-round auction including AcelRx and Melinta before La Jolla’s unsolicited all-cash offer with a CVR prevailed.
